messages:
Maya: Heads-up  Sales flagged ~20 legacy customers on bespoke tiers asking to be moved to our standardized tiers this quarter. We need a migration policy and runtime approach that preserves contractual SLAs/add-ons where required.
Sam: Customer ask summary: maintain current effective SLA + burst credits for 12 months. These are explicit in some contracts.
Ivy: I can pull the contracts but need clarity on what we must legally grandfather vs what we can change with notice.
LegalBot: If contract text includes explicit "service level", "priority capacity", or named "burst credits" clauses, those terms are binding until amended. Pricing SKUs and catalog names can generally be changed with 30d notice unless otherwise specified.
Ravi: Tech proposal: add tenant metadata flag "grandfathered_profile_id". Serving layer reads flag and applies legacy caps, routing priority, and billing tags. If capacity constrained, we must keep routing order for SLA-preserved tenants and only fall back to compatible variants subject to legal/ops review.
Jordan: That requires per-tenant routing rules + feature flags. Estimate: 2 sprints for tier mapper + 1 sprint for e2e tests and observability hooks. Test matrix doubles for affected routes.
Maya: Migration policy draft: preserve SLAs/add-ons when contract language mandates; preserve billing mechanics where required for X months; default migration window = 12 months; customers may opt in earlier. Need Sales playbook + opt-in/extension flow.
Sam: Sales needs an escalation path for >12 month extension requests: Sales -> RevOps -> Legal signoff?
Ivy: Agreed. Also need RevOps decision on whether to auto-issue retroactive credits if new tier is cheaper during overlap. Product should not assume crediting.
Ravi: Observability: emit events tenant_id, legacy_profile, migration_accepted_ts, sla_preserved boolean, routing_decision. Add per-tenant filter to existing dashboards.
Jordan: Rollout plan: pilot 5 diverse accounts (mix of high throughput, long-tail bursts, and reserved capacity). Gate rollout on pilot stability.
Maya: Launch criteria: (1) Legal-approved migration policy doc, (2) Sales playbook + email templates, (3) runtime flag + tier mapper implemented and QA'd, (4) telemetry for every migrated request, (5) pilot completion and rollback plan.
Sam: Ill gather pilot candidate list and start customer comms template.
Ravi: Ill draft the RFC for eng-runtime and include fallback semantics.
Jordan: Ill draft QA checklist and regression tests for both legacy and new tier paths.
Ivy: Looping in RevOps for crediting decision. Also will surface contracts with explicit SLA language.
Maya: Action items recap: Sam - pilot list by EOD Wed; Legal - list enforceable clauses and short decision memo; Ravi/Jordan - scope + pilot rollout plan and QA; Ivy - telemetry schema and RevOps contact. Wel sync next week for signoff.
